rationale.conceptual: The model is the paper's own custom formulation with multiple coupled PDEs and damage law, requiring genuine understanding and careful translation to code; it is not a standard library method.
rationale.execution: The pipeline involves coding the FE model, setting up geometry/mesh, running 11 simulations, and fitting exponents. Multi-stage with dependencies, but not overly long; standard tools can be used.

difficulty.reasoning: The task requires implementing a custom coupled multiphysics FE model (vacancy diffusion, stress equilibrium, heat transfer, electrical conduction, entropy-based damage, viscoplasticity) based on the paper's equations, then running an 11-condition parameter sweep to derive MTTF exponents. The conceptual challenge is high due to the interacting physics and non-trivial math; the execution requires orchestrating model implementation, mesh generation, and batch simulations.

compute_estimate.reasoning: 2D finite element transient nonlinear simulations on a moderate mesh; CPU-based solver; no external data; memory dominated by system matrices and solution fields.
